items.html: Frank de Caires was a right-hand middle-order batsman who made 80 and 70 in the first Test played in the Caribbean, when England were the visitors to Barbados in 1929-30. de Caires only played three Tests, though, the last of them in Jamaica in the same series. He toured Australia later that year but didn't play in any of the Tests.
